notes: geometry only: no inductance, EMI or current-capacity claim
bends are measured at joints of two straight items; arc joints are judged by tangency

chain anchors (not counted as joints): via centres and pad hits of the same net, junctions, width changes; degree2_joints / degree2_bends_90 count every node where exactly two straight items of one net and layer meet, anchors included (the degree-2 probe figure)
attribution 'pre_routed' needs --plan (pre_routed tracks); 'pad_link' = an item ending inside a pad of its net; everything else is 'router'
